transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. I'm a buyer, and... well, I just can't shake this feeling that people there, and maybe even some of the vendors, are tracking my buys. Like they're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor showed me reports saying that's not happening, but... I don't know. It just feels like they are. That's mainly why I'm here.
Do you think people are talking about you or watching you even when you're not at work?

I don't... I'm not really sure about outside of work. Like I just said, it's mostly the job that made me come in. I just can't shake it. The vendors, the launch numbers... it just feels like they're doing it on purpose to make me look stupid. Even if my boss says the reports don't show it... I just know it's happening there. That's really it.
Do you ever feel like people are talking about you or watching you when you're not at work?
Um... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said... no, not really. I don't notice anything like that outside of work. It's just... just the job.
Have you ever felt like something strange or unusual is going on outside of your job?
No. I mean... just normal stuff. I don't really know what else to tell you. It's just the job.
How long have you been feeling like people at work are tracking your buys and messing with the launch numbers?
Um... I guess it's been a while. Maybe... roughly ten months? Yeah, about ten months since I started noticing it all... and hearing the voice.
You mentioned hearing a voice, can you tell me more about what the voice says?

Um... it's just this guy's voice. I hear it sometimes when I'm alone. Like... if I'm in the stockroom or driving back from a vendor meeting. It sounds like he's right behind me. He just... he says things like, "Move faster, Scott," or he laughs at the products I pick out. But... when I turn around to look, there's nobody there.
Does the voice ever tell you to do something specific, or is it just commenting on what you're doing?
No, it doesn't... it doesn't really tell me to do things. Just... comments. Like I said.
Does the voice ever tell you to do something specific?
I... like I just said, no. It doesn't give me orders or anything. It just... talks.
Do you only hear the voice when you're thinking about work or doing work-related tasks?

I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't really kept track of it like that. I guess I just notice it more at work, but... I'm not sure. I don't really pay attention to what I'm thinking about when it happens.
Is the voice you hear ever related to anything other than your work?
I'm not sure. I guess maybe... I just don't really listen to it that closely.
Is the voice you hear something that happens all the time or does it come and go?

It... it comes and goes. Just sometimes. Like... if I'm in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting. I'll hear this man's voice. It sounds like it's right behind me... just saying, 'Move faster, Scott,' or... laughing at my picks. And then I turn around and nobody's there. So... yeah. It's not all the time.
Does the voice you hear ever tell you to do something that you feel you must do?
No... not really. It just... it just says the things I told you. It doesn't tell me I have to do anything.
Do you still believe that people at work are tracking your buys and messing with the launch numbers, even when your supervisor shows you reports saying that's not happening?

Yeah... I guess. I just... I can't shake the feeling. Even when my supervisor shows me those reports, it doesn't change anything. It still feels like people at work, and... and even some of the vendors... are tracking my buys. Like they're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. I don't know. That's... that's really what made me come in here.
Do you think your belief that people at work are tracking your buys and messing with the launch numbers could be wrong?
I don't... I mean, no. I don't think it's wrong. The reports don't... they don't prove anything to me. I just know what's happening. That's why I'm here.
Do you think it's possible that your feeling of being tracked at work is not based in reality?

No, I... I don't think it's just in my head. I already told you... that's the whole reason I came in. I just can't shake it. Even with those reports my supervisor has... it doesn't matter. I know the vendors and the people I work with are tracking what I buy and messing with the numbers. They just want me to look stupid.
Can you think of any evidence that would make you change your mind about people at work tracking your buys and messing with the launch numbers?

I don't... I don't know. Probably not. Like I said... that's why I'm here. I just can't shake the feeling. The reports my supervisor has... they don't prove anything to me. I just know they're doing it. They're tracking my buys and messing with the numbers so I look stupid.
Do you ever find it hard to express your thoughts or get your point across to others?
I don't think so. People usually understand me fine.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are disjointed or hard to follow?
No, not really. I mean, my thoughts make sense to me.
Have your thoughts about people tracking your buys and messing with the launch numbers ever changed or wavered since you first started having them?

No. Not really. ...Like I said, I just can't shake it. That's really what made me come in. 

It's just constant. The people at work, and um... even some of the vendors too. They're tracking my buys and messing with the launch numbers to make me look stupid. So... no. Even when my supervisor shows me those reports, it doesn't change my mind.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt extremely happy or irritable for no reason?

I guess so. Um... I get these stretches sometimes where I just feel like... I don't know, like the whole city is opening up for me. But then... if someone questions a purchase order or tells me to slow down... I snap. Probably way harder than I mean to.
